title: Cross-project support-claim and consumer-route reconciliation
mode: Primary-source cross-project research and plan refinement
scope: Compare current public capability claims with operation-specific documentation and issue evidence for LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdxf, FreeCAD, and LibreCAD_3.
Refine existing comparator and downstream-consumer evidence gates without adding findings, tests, fixtures, dependencies, or routine external validation.
Preserve existing fast local implementation cadence and the six deferred external items.

sources.revision: Mutable repository README and Texinfo manual source inspected 2026-10-20; no source commit or executable was pinned or run.
sources.observed: The repository README gives approximate 90% DWG-to-DXF and 80% DXF-to-DWG figures, says DXF-to-DWG is R2000-only, and documents DWG writing through R2004. The manual separately describes approximately 99% read/mostly-write coverage through R2018, while stating R2007 writing is not implemented and the default writer uses R2004 or earlier.
sources.limits: The pages do not publish a common per-entity denominator or reconciled operation/version matrix. Percentages are descriptive only and do not establish any exact binary's behavior.

sources.revision: Mutable README and issue report inspected 2026-10-20; issue #1253 names ACadSharp 3.6.35 and AutoCAD 2027; no package or executable was run.
sources.observed: The README declares DWG/DXF read and write availability separately by AC version. Issue #1253 reports that AutoCAD rejected peer-generated DXF that more permissive readers accepted and describes an accoreconsole check; follow-up discussion qualifies the HATCH group-47 observation for derived boundaries.
sources.limits: The report is not a libdxfrw result or a universal DXF rule. Its proposed field changes must be checked against normative/profile evidence and the exact output version.

sources.project: FreeCAD documentation and libdxfrw converter profile
sources.revision: FreeCAD documentation page and libdxfrw README inspected 2026-10-20; the documentation repository reports archived status since 2026-04-01. The README describes FreeCAD 1.1.3 revision 145529fe741292ff0b3977a01195bf0247425794 on macOS 27 arm64; no native run was performed in this research pass.
sources.observed: The FreeCAD guide distinguishes C++ and legacy Python DXF importers, lists different entity scopes, and states stock FreeCAD cannot read ACIS/SAT solid blobs. The current libdxfrw README documents one narrow macOS/C++ importer/PATH converter route using a generated AC1015 nonzero-Z LINE and leaves Linux/Windows unqualified.
sources.limits: Archived documentation is a route-selection aid, not current-binary qualification. The guide's general file-format statement about 1:1 conversion cannot establish the behavior of a specific converter/importer route or override its stated importer limits.

sources.revision: Mutable master documentation inspected 2026-10-20; the DWG policy refers to its pinned libdxfrw revision, which was not resolved to a commit in this research pass.
sources.observed: The policy describes DWG import as opt-in, off by default, experimental and read-only; the stated pinned ledger has 15 read-direction claims (11 EXPERIMENTAL, 4 PENDING_NATIVE, zero PROMOTED) and no write claims. DWG-origin documents remain non-writable and are saved as DXF.
sources.limits: This is downstream product policy and a claim-ledger snapshot, not independent codec or DWG-writer evidence.

sources.revision: Mutable master documentation inspected 2026-10-20; no release or runtime was pinned or run.
sources.observed: The XREF importer documents a bounded copyable/transformable subset and states that ACAD_TABLE, preserved unknown/proxy content, and many document features may be unsupported or ignored without an exception.
sources.limits: XREF transfer behavior does not establish ordinary strict parser behavior, whole-document preservation, or ACIS/B-rep semantics.

sources.revision: Shared worktree plan inspected and updated 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: PAR-05/7BQ.5 already owns strict output-profile checks, PAR-07/S8 owns exact comparator admission and per-source disposition, and existing consumer gates separate converter, importer, modeler-carrier, and semantic results. This update sharpens those existing gates rather than creating duplicate work.
sources.limits: No code, test, fixture, external package, peer executable, native CAD app, or geometry kernel was run.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-05/7BQ.5: keep strict output syntax acceptance separate from self-readback and avoid universalizing issue-specific group-code recommendations.
PAR-07/S8: bind comparator results to immutable source/release, version, direction, operation, options, and per-source dispositions; do not score aggregate coverage percentages.
Consumer gates: distinguish converter output, selected importer/backend, imported source-handle outcomes, raw modeler-carrier retention, independent semantic geometry, and native acceptance.
LibreCAD_3: preserve default 2D/API compatibility and optional read-only DWG import; do not infer DWG write or 3D application requirements from library implementation work.
Validation cadence: retain focused local tests per slice and external/native gates at existing composed milestones only.

planChanges: Documented the mismatch in scope/provenance between LibreDWG's public operation-specific percentage claims and versioned manual, and prohibited scoring by project-wide percentages.
Mapped ACadSharp's version/direction matrix and AutoCAD-rejection report to the existing strict-output gate without importing peer issue recommendations as format rules.
Recorded that FreeCAD's archived importer documentation is a route-selection aid and kept its narrow macOS converter/importer qualification separate from Linux/Windows and ACIS claims.
Made LibreCAD_3's read-only, opt-in policy and read-only claim-ledger status explicit as product governance rather than codec qualification.
Specified the implementation-ready comparator envelope and per-source handle disposition while preserving current test cadence and self-unblocking behavior.
limitations: Public repository documentation and issue states are mutable; exact releases, source commits, binary hashes, and platform routes must be pinned at any future composed checkpoint.
No peer or native program was executed and no external drawing or fixture was fetched.
ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout; Autodesk references remain authoritative for published DXF group schemas.
No new local defect, numbered finding, implementation-order change, dependency, or support promotion was established.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
